name: 레녹스
motion_summary: Eternal Return Lenox Blue Viper: short moss-green hair, clear teal eyes, red-black street fighter outfit per exact reference, long whip. R is TWO QUICK DIAGONAL WHIP LASHES forming an X. No literal snake creature. Frames ready; whip hand behind shoulder; body coils left; first upper-left to lower-right lash with thin cyan trail; first diagonal fully extended; wrist retracts and torso reverses; opposite diagonal windup; second upper-right to lower-left lash; both blue trails briefly form readable X to right of character; long whip falls into loop; return upright; ready. Hands, shoulder, torso and legs visibly brace/change. Cyan/blue whip cuts, tiny restrained sparks, no generic portal and no stationary aura. Keep both eyes/mouth visible and each effect inside its square.
